subject: Post-call: Novus Health discovery — procurement gates & MAP draft
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novushealth.io>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@novushealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Novus Health discovery — procurement gates & MAP draft

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks for taking time this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Call summary (5 min):
- Use case: clinical documentation acceleration for outpatient clinic notes (primary benefit: provider time saved + faster billing).
- Volume profile: ~1200 active providers, average 50 daily notes per provider, median length ~600 tokens.
- Success criteria: 20% reduction in average documentation time + <250ms 95p latency for in-UI completions.

Important stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: Marcus Li (VP Product & Ops) — controls budget and go/no-go.
- Procurement lead: Sofia Gomez — handles T&Cs and SOW.
- Security contact: Amit Patel (infosec) — will require SOC2 report, data retention policy, and architecture diagram.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached: Novus_MAP_v0.1.xlsx):
1) Intro meeting with Marcus (week of 6/1) — discuss business metrics and commit to executive sponsor ask.
2) Security evidence runbook (due 6/8) — Redwood to provide SOC2 report, network diagram, and data handling overview.
3) Procurement packet (due 6/10) — draft SOW + pricing cadence to procurement for review.
4) Pilot design and success metrics (due 6/17) — define sample cohorts and monitoring plan.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Elena / Sofia: confirm procurement timeline and any required internal docs beyond the checklist.
- Marcus: please confirm whether procurement needs PO-first vs. contract-first ordering.
- Marissa / Ben (internal): can you assemble a short ROI one-pager + latency benchmarks for the proposed pilot? I linked a template.

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (MAP draft), Redwood_ROI-onepager.pdf (template)

If this looks right I’ll schedule the Marcus intro and drop a security packet in the shared Drive.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming people and timelines from our side:
- Marcus Li: confirmed as econ buyer and available for a 30-min sync on Tue 1 Jun between 10–12 PST.
- Sofia Gomez: procurement lead; her team prefers contract-first unless the pilot is <$25k, in which case a PO can be issued after pilot sign-off.
- Amit Patel (infosec): I’ve looped him on this thread, he asked for a copy of your SOC2 and a short architecture diagram. He also requested data retention and deletion policy for PII.

I attached our procurement checklist (Novus_procurement_checklist.pdf) — it lists standard redlines and an expected 2–3 week procurement review once a clean contract is submitted.

Small ask: could you call out what the pilot pricing bands look like for 30/90/180-day pilots? That will help Sofia build the MSA exceptions if needed.

Elena Rossi
Director, Digital Transformation | Novus Health
elena@novushealth.io
